text: Seabrook Town successfully exploited their 3-4-3 formation and wide, crossing style by launching a swift counter-attack immediately after Harbour City's clearance, culminating in Kian Romano’s goal at 90+3'. Their build-up featured just three well-chosen passes progressing from deep in their half to a high xG chance close to goal, aided by Tomas Kowalski's key short assist. The dominance in possession and field tilt in the final minutes allowed them to maintain pressure and create opportunities, whereas Harbour City failed to register a single shot or big chance late on. For coaching focus, emphasize quick transitions and forward passing in response to opponent clearances to capitalize on moments of vulnerability.
